A green starfighter [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] that strongly resembles a a downsized [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] at some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A key difference between this fighter and its more commonplace look-alike is the presence of onboard [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], located in nacelles that are folded under the fighter when not in use. These nacelles also provide a location for two [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]].<ref name="Hasbro" />
